# bitbucket_repository (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Bitbucket Cloud repository by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_repository" "api" {
  slug = "payments-api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Repository slug.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Repository description.
- `fork_policy` (String) Fork policy.
- `has_issues` (Boolean) Whether the issue tracker is enabled.
- `has_wiki` (Boolean) Whether the wiki is enabled.
- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/slug".
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the repository is private.
- `language` (String) Main programming language, as reported by Bitbucket.
- `main_branch` (String) Name of the repository's default branch.
- `name` (String) Repository display name.
- `project_key` (String) Key of the Bitbucket project this repository belongs to.
